entities.summary: The Toyota 1HZ is a straight-six diesel engine developed and produced by Toyota beginning in 1990. It continues to be offered in the Toyota 70 series and Toyota Coaster sold in countries with low or no emissions regulations, and it is also in Landcruiser 70s sold by Toyota Gibraltar Stockholdings for organisations such as the United Nations and other NGOs. Formerly the Engine was present in the Landcruiser 80 and Landcruiser 100 before being replaced.
